1.t: The command of Allah is at hand, so do not hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him in worship˺
1.tr: Ataaa amrul laahi falaa tasta'jilooh; Subhaanahoo Wa-Ta'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon

2.t: He sends down the angels with revelation by His command to whoever He wills of His servants, ˹stating:˺ “Warn ˹humanity˺ that there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so be mindful of Me ˹alone˺.”
2.tr: Yunazzilul malaaa-'ikata birroohi min amrihee 'alaa mai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadiheee an anzirooo annahoo laaa ilaaha illaaa ana fattaqoon

3.t: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. Exalted is He above what they associate with Him ˹in worship˺
3.tr: Khalaqas samaawaati wal-arda bilhaqq; Ta'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon

4.t: He created humans from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Him˺
4.tr: Khalaqal insaana min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen

5.t: And He created the cattle for you as a source of warmth, food, and ˹many other˺ benefits
5.tr: Wal-an-'amaa khalaqahaa; lakum feehaa dif'unw Wa-manaafi'u Wa-minhaa taakuloon

6.t: They are also pleasing to you when you bring them home and when you take them out to graze
6.tr: Wa-lakum feehaa jamaalun heena tureehoona Wa-heena tasrahoon

7.t: And they carry your loads to ˹distant˺ lands which you could not otherwise reach without great hardship. Surely your Lord is Ever Gracious, Most Merciful
7.tr: Wa-tahmilu asqaalakum ilaa baladil lam takoonoo baaligheehi illaa bishiqqil anfus; inna Rabbakum la-Ra'oofur Raheem

8.t: ˹He also created˺ horses, mules, and donkeys for your transportation and adornment. And He creates what you do not know
8.tr: Walkhaila wal-bighaala wal-hameera litarkaboohaa Wa-zeenah; Wa-yakhluqu maa laa ta'lamoon

9.t: It is upon Allah ˹alone˺ to ˹clearly˺ show the Straight Way. Other ways are deviant. Had He willed, He would have easily imposed guidance upon all of you
9.tr: Wa-'alal laahi qasdus sabeeli Wa-minhaa jaaa'ir; Wa-law shaaa'a lahadaakum ajma'een

10.t: He is the One Who sends down rain from the sky, from which you drink and by which plants grow for your cattle to graze
10.tr: Huwal lazeee anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'al lakum minhu sharaabunw Wa-minhu shajarun feehi tuseemoon

11.t: With it He produces for you ˹various˺ crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and every type of fruit. Surely in this is a sign for those who reflect
11.tr: Yumbitu lakum bihiz zar'a wazzaitoona wanna-kheela wal-a'naaba Wa-min kullis samaraat, inna fee zaalika la-Aayatal liqawminy yatafakkaroon

12.t: And He has subjected for your benefit the day and the night, the sun and the moon. And the stars have been subjected by His command. Surely in this are signs for those who understand
12.tr: Wa-sakkhkhara lakumul laila wannahaara wash-shamsa walqamara wannujoomu musakhkharaatum bi-amrih; inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatil liqawminy ya'qiloon

13.t: And ˹He subjected˺ for you whatever He has created on earth of varying colours. Surely in this is a sign for those who are mindful
13.tr: Wa-maa zara-a lakum fil ardi mukhtalifan alwaanuh; inna fee zaalika la-Aayatal liqawminy yazakkaroon

14.t: And He is the One Who has subjected the sea, so from it you may eat tender seafood and extract ornaments to wear. And you see the ships ploughing their way through it, so you may seek His bounty and give thanks ˹to Him˺
14.tr: Wa-Huwal lazee sakhkharal bahra litaakuloo minhu lahman tariyyanw Wa-tastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonahaa Wa-taral fulka mawaakhira feehi Wa-litabtaghoo min fadlihee Wa-la'allakum tashkuroon

15.t: He has placed into the earth firm mountains, so it does not shake with you, as well as rivers, and pathways so you may find your way
15.tr: Wa-alqaa fil ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum Wa-anhaaranw Wa-sublulal la-'allakum tahtadoon

16.t: Also by landmarks and stars do people find their way

17.t: Can the One Who creates be equal to those who do not? Will you not then be mindful
17.tr: Afamany yakhluqu kamal laa yakhluq; afalaa tazak-karoon

18.t: If you tried to count Allah’s blessings, you would never be able to number them. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
18.tr: Wa-in ta'uddoo ni'matal laahi laa tuhsoohaa; innal laaha la-Ghafoorur Raheem

19.t: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal
19.tr: Wallaahu ya'lamu maa tusirroona Wa-maa tu'linoon

20.t: But those ˹idols˺ they invoke besides Allah cannot create anything—they themselves are created
20.tr: Wallazeena yad'oona min doonil laahi laa yakhluqoona shai'anw Wa-hum yukhlaqoon

21.t: They are dead, not alive—not even knowing when their followers will be resurrected
21.tr: Amwaatun ghairu ahyaaa'inw Wa-maa yash'uroona aiyaana yub'asoon

22.t: Your God is ˹only˺ One God. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are in denial, and they are too proud
22.tr: Illahukum Ilaahunw Waahid; fallazeena laa yu'minoona bil-Aakhirati quloobuhum munkiratunw Wa-hum mustakbiroon

23.t: Without a doubt, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He certainly does not like those who are too proud
23.tr: Laa jarama annal laaha ya'lamu maa yusirrona Wa-ma yu'linoon; innahoo laa yuhibbul mustakbireen

24.t: And when it is said to them, “What has your Lord revealed?” They say, “Ancient fables!”
24.tr: Wa-izaa qeela lahum maazaaa anzala Rabbukum qaaloo asaateerul awwaleen

25.t: Let them bear their burdens in full on the Day of Judgment as well as some of the burdens of those they mislead without knowledge. Evil indeed is what they will bear
25.tr: Liyahmilooo awzaarahum kaamilatany Yawmal Qiyaamati Wa-min awzaaril lazeena yudilloonahum bighairi 'ilm; alaa saaa'a maa yaziroon

26.t: Indeed, those before them had plotted, but Allah struck at the ˹very˺ foundation of their structure, so the roof collapsed on top of them, and the torment came upon them from where they did not expect
26.tr: Qad makaral lazeena min qablihim fa-atal laahu bunyaa-nahum minal qawaa'idi fakharra 'alaihimus saqfu min fawqihim Wa-ataahumul 'azaabu min haisu laa yash'uroon

27.t: Then on the Day of Judgment He will humiliate them and say, “Where are My ˹so-called˺ associate-gods for whose sake you used to oppose ˹the believers˺?” Those gifted with knowledge will say, “Surely disgrace and misery today are upon the disbelievers.”
27.tr: Summa Yawmal Qiyaamati yukhzeehim Wa-yaqoolu aina shurakaaa'iyal lazeena kuntum tushaaaqqoona feehim; qaalal lazeena ootul 'ilma innal khizyal Yawma wassooo'a 'alal kaafireen

28.t: Those whose souls the angels seize while they wrong themselves will then offer ˹full˺ submission ˹and say falsely,˺ “We did not do any evil.” ˹The angels will say,˺ “No! Surely Allah fully knows what you used to do
28.tr: Allazeena tatawaf-faahu-mul malaaa'ikatu zaalimeee anfusihim fa-alqawus salama maa kunnaa na'malu min sooo'; balaaa innal laaha 'aleemum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

29.t: So enter the gates of Hell, to stay there forever. Indeed, what an evil home for the arrogant!”
29.tr: Fadkhulooo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feeha falabi'sa maswal mutakab-bireen

30.t: And ˹when˺ it is said to those mindful ˹of Allah˺, “What has your Lord revealed?” They say, “All the best!” For those who do good in this world, there is goodness. But far better is the ˹eternal˺ Home of the Hereafter. How excellent indeed is the home of the righteous
30.tr: Wa-qeela lillazeenat taqaw maazaaa anzala Rabbukum; qaaloo khairaa; lillazeena ahsanoo fee haazihid dunyaa hasanah; Wa-la-Daarul Aakhirati khair; Wa-lani'ma daarul muttaqeen

31.t: the Gardens of Eternity which they will enter, under which rivers flow. In it they will have whatever they desire. This is how Allah rewards the righteous—
31.tr: Jannaatu 'Adniny yadkhuloonahaa tajree min tahtihal anhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaaa'oon; kazaalika yajzil laahul muttaqeen

32.t: those whose souls the angels take while they are virtuous, saying ˹to them˺, “Peace be upon you! Enter Paradise for what you used to do.”
32.tr: Allazeena tatawaf-faahumul malaaa'ikatu taiyibeena yaqooloona salaamun 'alai-kumud khulul Jannata bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

33.t: Are they only awaiting the coming of the angels or the command of your Lord ˹O Prophet˺? So were those before them. And Allah never wronged them, but it was they who wronged themselves
33.tr: Hal yanzuroona illaaa an taatiyahumul malaaa'ikatu aw yaatiya amru Rabbik; kazaalika fa'alal lazeena min qablihim; Wa-maa zalamahumul laahu Wa-laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon

34.t: Then the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds overtook them, and they were overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule
34.tr: Fa-asaabahum saiyi-aatu maa 'amiloo Wa-haaqa bihim maa kaano bihee yastahzi'oon

35.t: The polytheists argue, “Had Allah willed, neither we nor our forefathers would have worshipped anything other than Him, nor prohibited anything without His command.” So did those before them. Is not the messengers’ duty only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly
35.tr: Wa-qaalal lazeena ashrakoo law shaaa'al laahu ma 'abadnaa min doonihee min shai'in nahnu Wa-laaa aabaaa'unaa Wa-laa harramnaa min doonihee min shai'; kazaalika fa'alal lazeena min qablihim fahal 'alar Rusuli illal balaaghul mubeen

36.t: We surely sent a messenger to every community, saying, “Worship Allah and shun false gods.” But some of them were guided by Allah, while others were destined to stray. So travel throughout the land and see the fate of the deniers
36.tr: Wa-laqad ba'asnaa fee kulli ummatir Rasoolan ani' budul laaha wajtanibut Taaghoota faminhum man hadal laahu Wa-minhum man haqqat 'alaihid dalaalah; faseeroo fil ardi fanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen

37.t: Even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are keen on their guidance, Allah certainly does not guide those He leaves to stray, and they will have no helpers
37.tr: In tahris 'alaa hudaahum fa-innal laaha laa yahdee mai yudillu Wa-maa lahum min naasireen

38.t: They swear by Allah their most solemn oaths that Allah will never raise the dead to life. Yes ˹He will˺! It is a true promise binding on Him, but most people do not know
38.tr: Wa-aqsamoo billaahi jahda aimaanihim laa yab'asul laahu mai yamoot; balaa wa'dan 'alaihi haqqanw Wa-laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon

39.t: ˹He will do that˺ to make clear to them what they disagreed on, and for the disbelievers to know that they were liars
39.tr: Liyubaiyina lahumul lazee yakhtalifoona feehi Wa-liya'lamal lazeena kafarooo annahum kaanoo kaazibeen

40.t: If We ever will something ˹to exist˺, all We say is: “Be!” And it is
40.tr: Innamaa qawlunaa lishay'in izaa aradnaahu an naqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon

41.t: As for those who emigrated in ˹the cause of˺ Allah after being persecuted, We will surely bless them with a good home in this world. But the reward of the Hereafter is far better, if only they knew
41.tr: Wallazeena haajaroo fil laahi mim ba'di maa zulimoo lanubawwi'-annahum fid dunyaa hasanatanw Wa-la-ajrul Aakhirati akbar; law kaanoo ya'lamoon

42.t: ˹It is˺ they who have patiently endured, and in their Lord they put their trust

43.t: We did not send ˹messengers˺ before you ˹O Prophet˺ except mere men inspired by Us. If you ˹polytheists˺ do not know ˹this already˺, then ask those who have knowledge ˹of the Scriptures˺
43.tr: Wa-maaa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan nooheee ilaihim; fas'alooo ahlaz zikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon

44.t: ˹We sent them˺ with clear proofs and divine Books. And We have sent down to you ˹O Prophet˺ the Reminder, so that you may explain to people what has been revealed for them, and perhaps they will reflect
44.tr: Bilbaiyinaati waz-Zubur; Wa-anzalnaaa ilaikaz Zikra litubaiyina linnaasi maa nuzzila ilaihim Wa-la'allahum yatafakkaroon

45.t: Do those who devise evil plots feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them? Or that the torment will not come upon them in ways they cannot comprehend
45.tr: Afa-aminal lazeena makarus saiyi-aati ai yakhsifal laahu bihimul arda aw yaaa-tiyahumul 'azaabu min haisu laa yash'uroon

46.t: Or that He will not seize them while they go about ˹their day˺, for then they will have no escape
46.tr: Aw yaakhuzahum fee taqallubihim famaa hum bi-mu'jizeen

47.t: Or that He will not destroy them gradually? But your Lord is truly Ever Gracious, Most Merciful
47.tr: Aw yaakhuzahum 'alaa takhawwuf; fa-inna Rabbakum la-Ra'oofur Raheem

48.t: Have they not considered how the shadows of everything Allah has created incline to the right and the left ˹as the sun moves˺, totally submitting to Allah in all humility
48.tr: Awa-lam yaraw ilaa maa khalaqal laahu min shai'iny yatafaiya'u zilaaluhoo 'anil yameeni washshamaaa'-ili sujjadal lillaahi Wa-hum daakhiroon

49.t: And to Allah ˹alone˺ bows down ˹in submission˺ whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of living creatures, as do the angels—who are not too proud ˹to do so˺
49.tr: Wa-lillaahi yasjudu maa fis samaawaati Wa-maa fil ardi min daaabbatinw walma-laaa'ikatu Wa-hum laa yastakbiroon

50.t: They fear their Lord above them, and do whatever they are commanded
50.tr: yakhaafoona Rabbahum min fawqihim Wa-yaf'aloona maa yu'maroon

51.t: And Allah has said, “Do not take two gods. There is only One God. So be in awe of Me ˹alone˺.”
51.tr: Wa-qaalal laahu laa tatta-khizooo ilaahainis naini innamaa Huwa Ilaahunw Waahid; fa-iyyaaya farhaboon

52.t: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him ˹alone˺ is the everlasting devotion. Will you then fear any other than Allah
52.tr: Wa-lahoo maa fis samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-lahud deenu waasibaa; afaghairal laahi tattaqoon

53.t: Whatever blessings you have are from Allah. Then whenever hardship touches you, to Him ˹alone˺ you cry ˹for help˺
53.tr: Wa-maa bikum min ni'matin faminal laahi summa izaa massakumud durru fa-ilaihi taj'aroon

54.t: Then as soon as He removes the hardship from you, a group of you associates ˹others˺ with their Lord ˹in worship˺
54.tr: Summaa izaa kashafad durra 'ankum izaa fareequm minkum bi-Rabbihim yushrikoon

55.t: only returning Our favours with ingratitude. So enjoy yourselves, for you will soon know
55.tr: Liyakfuroo bimaa aatainaahum; fatamatta'oo, faswfa ta'lamoon

56.t: And they ˹even˺ assign to those ˹idols˺—who know nothing—a share of what We have provided for them. By Allah! You will certainly be questioned about whatever ˹lies˺ you used to fabricate ˹against Allah˺
56.tr: Wa-yaj'aloona limaa laa ya'lamoona naseebam mimmaa razaqnnaahum; tallaahi latus'alunaa 'ammaa kuntum taftaroon

57.t: And they attribute ˹angels as˺ daughters to Allah—glory be to Him!—the opposite of what they desire for themselves
57.tr: Wa-yaj'aloona lillaahil banaati Subhaanahoo Wa-lahum maa yashtahoon

58.t: Whenever one of them is given the good news of a baby girl, his face grows gloomy, as he suppresses his rage
58.tr: Wa-izaa bushshira ahaduhum bil-unsaa zalla wajhuhoo muswaddanw Wa-huwa kazeem

59.t: He hides himself from the people because of the bad news he has received. Should he keep her in disgrace, or bury her ˹alive˺ in the ground? Evil indeed is their judgment
59.tr: yatawaaraa minal qawmi min sooo'i maa bushshira bih; a-yumsikuhoo 'alaa hoonin am yadussuhoo fit turaab; alaa saaa'a maa yahkumoon

60.t: To those who disbelieve in the Hereafter belong all evil qualities, whereas to Allah belong the finest attributes. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
60.tr: Lillazeena laa yu'minoona bil-Aakhirati masalus saw'i Wa-lillaahil masalul a'laa; Wa-Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem

61.t: If Allah were to punish people ˹immediately˺ for their wrongdoing, He would not have left a single living being on earth. But He delays them for an appointed term. And when their time arrives, they cannot delay it for a moment, nor could they advance it
61.tr: Wa-law yu'aakhizul laahun naasa bizulminhim maa taraka 'alaihaa min daaabbatinw Wa-laakiny yu'akhkhiruhum ilaaa ajalim musamman fa-izaa jaaa'a ajaluhum laa yastaakhiroona saa'atanw Wa-laa yastaqdimoon

62.t: They attribute to Allah what they hate ˹for themselves˺, and their tongues utter the lie that they will have the finest reward. Without a doubt, for them is the Fire, where they will be abandoned
62.tr: Wa-yaj'aloona lillaahi maa yakrahoona Wa-tasifu alsinatuhumul kaziba anna lahumul husnaa laa jarama anna lahumun Naara Wa-annahum mufratoon

63.t: By Allah! We have surely sent messengers to communities before you ˹O Prophet˺, but Satan made their misdeeds appealing to them. So he is their patron today, and they will suffer a painful punishment
63.tr: Tallaahi laqad arsalnaaa ilaaa umamim min qablika fazayyana lahumush Shaitaanu a'maalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumul yawma Wa-lahum 'azaabun aleem

64.t: We have revealed to you the Book only to clarify for them what they differed about, and as a guide and mercy for those who believe
64.tr: Wa-maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Kitaaba illaa litubaiyina lahumul lazikh talafoo feehi Wa-hudanw Wa-rahmatal liqawminy yu'minoon

65.t: And Allah sends down rain from the sky, giving life to the earth after its death. Surely in this is a sign for those who listen
65.tr: Wallaahu anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa-ahyaa bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa; inna fee zaalika la-aayatal liqaw-miny yasma'oon

66.t: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle: We give you to drink of what is in their bellies, from between digested food and blood: pure milk, pleasant to drink
66.tr: Wa-inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmmaa fee butoonihee mim baini farsinw Wa-damil labanann khaalisan saaa'ighallish shaaribeen

67.t: And from the fruits of palm trees and grapevines you derive intoxicants as well as wholesome provision. Surely in this is a sign for those who understand
67.tr: Wa-min samaraatin nakheeli wal-a'nnaabi tattakhizoona minhu sakaranw Wa-rizqann hasanaa; inna fee zaalika la-Aayatal liqawmien ya'qiloon

68.t: And your Lord inspired the bees: “Make ˹your˺ homes in the mountains, the trees, and in what people construct
68.tr: Wa-awhaa Rabbuka ilan nahli anit takhizee minal jabaali buyootanw Wa-minash shajari Wa-mimmaa ya'rishoon

69.t: and feed from ˹the flower of˺ any fruit ˹you please˺ and follow the ways your Lord has made easy for you.” From their bellies comes forth liquid of varying colours, in which there is healing for people. Surely in this is a sign for those who reflect
69.tr: Summma kulee min kullis samaraati faslukee subula Rabbiki zululaa; yakhruju mim butoonihaa sharaabum mukh-talifun alwaanuhoo feehi shifaaa'ul linnaas, innna fee zaalika la-Aayatal liqawmien yatafakkaroon

70.t: Allah has created you, and then causes you to die. And some of you are left to reach the most feeble stage of life so that they may know nothing after having known much. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, Most Capable
70.tr: Wallaahu khalaqakum suma tatawaffaakum; Wa-minkum maien yuradu ilaaa arzalil 'umuri likai laa ya'lama ba'da 'ilmin shai'aa; innal laaha 'Aleemun Qadeer

71.t: And Allah has favoured some of you over others in provision. But those who have been much favoured would not share their wealth with those ˹bondspeople˺ in their possession, making them their equals. Do they then deny Allah’s favours
71.tr: Wallaahu faddala ba'dakum 'alaa ba'din fir rizq; famal lazeena fuddiloo biraaaddee rizqihim 'alaa maa malakat aimaanuhum fahum feehi sawaaa'; afabini'matil laahi yajhadoon

72.t: And Allah has made for you spouses of your own kind, and given you through your spouses children and grandchildren. And He has granted you good, lawful provisions. Are they then faithful to falsehood and ungrateful for Allah’s favours
72.tr: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajanw Wa-ja'ala lakum min azwaajikum baneena Wa-hafadatanw Wa-razaqakum minat taiyyibaat; afabil-baatili yu'minoona Wa-bini'matil laahi hum yakkfuroon

73.t: Yet they worship besides Allah those ˹idols˺ who do not afford them any provision from the heavens and the earth, nor do they have the power to
73.tr: Wa-ya'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yamliku lahum rizqam minas samaawaati wal-ardi shai'anw Wa-laa yastatee'oon

74.t: So do not set up equals to Allah, for Allah certainly knows and you do not know
74.tr: Falaa tadriboo lillaahil amsaal; innal laaha ya'lamu Wa-antum laa ta'lamoon

75.t: Allah sets forth a parable: a slave who lacks all means, compared to a ˹free˺ man to whom We granted a good provision, of which he donates ˹freely,˺ openly and secretly. Are they equal? Praise be to Allah. In fact, most of them do not know
75.tr: Darabal laahu masalan 'abdam mammlookal laa yaqdiru 'alaa shai'inw Wa-mar razaqnaahu mminnaa rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirranw Wa-jahra; hal yasta-woon; alhamdu lillaah; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoon

76.t: And Allah sets forth a parable of two men: one of them is dumb, incapable of anything. He is a burden on his master. Wherever he is sent, he brings no good. Can such a person be equal to the one who commands justice and is on the Straight Path
76.tr: Wa-darabal laahu masalar rajulaini ahaduhumaaa abkamu laa yaqdiru 'alaa shai'inw Wa-huwa kallun 'alaa mawlaahu ainamaa yuwajjihhu laa yaati bikhairin hal yastawee huwa Wa-maien yaamuru bil'adli Wa-huwa 'alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

77.t: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs ˹the knowledge of˺ the unseen in the heavens and the earth. Bringing about the Hour would only take the blink of an eye, or even less. Surely Allah is Most Capable of everything
77.tr: Wa-lillaahi ghaibus samaawaati wal-ard; Wa-maaa amrus Saa'ati illaa kalamhil basari aw huwa aqrab; innal laaha 'alaaa kulli shai'in Qadeer

78.t: And Allah brought you out of the wombs of your mothers while you knew nothing, and gave you hearing, sight, and intellect so perhaps you would be thankful
78.tr: Wallaahu akhrajakum mim butooni ummahaatikum laa ta'lamoona shai'anw Wa-ja'ala lakumus sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata la'allakum tashkuroon

79.t: Have they not seen the birds glide in the open sky? None holds them up except Allah. Surely in this are signs for those who believe
79.tr: Alam yaraw ilat tairi musakhkharaatin fee jawwis samaaa'i maa yumsikuhunna illal laah; inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatil liqawminy yu'minoon

80.t: And Allah has made your homes a place to rest, and has given you tents from the hide of animals, light to handle when you travel and when you camp. And out of their wool, fur, and hair He has given you furnishings and goods for a while
80.tr: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum mim buyootikum sakananw Wa-ja'ala lakum min juloodil an'aami buyootan tastakhif-foonahaa yawma za'nikum Wa-yawma iqaamatikum Wa-min aswaafihaa Wa-awbaarihaa Wa-ash'aarihaaa asaasanw Wa-mataa'an ilaa heen

81.t: And Allah has provided you shade out of what He created, and has given you shelter in the mountains. He has also provided you with clothes protecting you from the heat ˹and cold˺, and armour shielding you in battle. This is how He perfects His favour upon you, so perhaps you will ˹fully˺ submit ˹to Him˺
81.tr: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum mimmaa khalaqa zilaalanw Wa-ja'ala lakum minal jibaali aknaananw Wa-ja'ala lakum saraabeela taqeekumul harra Wa-saraabeela taqeekum baasakum; kazaalika yutimmu ni'matahoo alaikum la'allakum tuslimoon

82.t: But if they turn away, then your duty ˹O Prophet˺ is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly

83.t: They are aware of Allah’s favours, but still deny them. And most of them are ˹truly˺ ungrateful
83.tr: Ya'rifoona ni'matal laahi summa yunkiroonahaa Wa-aksaruhumul kaafiroon

84.t: ˹Consider, O Prophet,˺ the Day We will call ˹a prophet as˺ a witness from every faith-community. Then the disbelievers will neither be allowed to plead nor appease ˹their Lord˺
84.tr: Wa-yawma nab'asu min kulli ummatin shaheedan summa laa yu'zanu lillazeena kafaroo Wa-laa hum yusta'taboon

85.t: And when the wrongdoers face the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be delayed ˹from it˺
85.tr: Wa-izaa ra al-lazeena zalamul 'azaaba falaa yukhaf-fafu 'anhum Wa-laa hum yunzaroon

86.t: And when the polytheists see their associate-gods, they will say, “Our Lord! These are our associate-gods that we used to invoke besides You.” Their gods will throw a rebuttal at them, ˹saying,˺ “You are definitely liars.”
86.tr: Wa-izaa ra al-lazeena ashrakoo shurakaaa'ahum qaaloo Rabbana haaa'ulaaa'i shurakaaa'unal lazeena kunnaa nad'oo min doonika fa-alqaw ilaihimul qawla innakum lakaaziboon

87.t: They will offer ˹full˺ submission to Allah on that Day, and whatever ˹gods˺ they fabricated will fail them
87.tr: Wa-alqaw ilal laahi yawma'izinis salama Wa-dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon

88.t: For those who disbelieve and hinder ˹others˺ from the Way of Allah, We will add more punishment to their punishment for all the corruption they spread
88.tr: Allazeena kafaroo Wa-saddoo 'an sabeelil laahi zidnaahum 'azaaban fawqal 'azaabi bimaa kaanoo yufsidoon

89.t: ˹Consider, O Prophet,˺ the Day We will call against every faith-community a witness of their own. And We will call you to be a witness against these ˹people of yours˺. We have revealed to you the Book as an explanation of all things, a guide, a mercy, and good news for those who ˹fully˺ submit
89.tr: Wa-yawma nab'asu fee kulli ummmatin shaheedan 'alaihim min anfusihim Wa-ji'naa bika shaheedan 'alaa haaa'ulaaa'; Wa-nazzalnaa 'alaikal Kitaaba tibyaanal likulli shai'inw Wa-hudanw Wa-rahmatanw Wa-bushraa lilmuslimeen

90.t: Indeed, Allah commands justice, grace, as well as courtesy to close relatives. He forbids indecency, wickedness, and aggression. He instructs you so perhaps you will be mindful
90.tr: Innal laaha ya'muru bil-'adli wal-ihsaani Wa-eetaaa'i zil qurbaa Wa-yanhaa 'anil fahshaaa'i wal-munkari walbagh-i' ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkaroon

91.t: Honour Allah’s covenant when you make a pledge, and do not break your oaths after confirming them, having made Allah your guarantor. Surely Allah knows all you do
91.tr: Wa-awfoo bi-Ahdil laahi izaa 'aahattum Wa-laa tanqudul aimaana ba'da tawkeedihaa Wa-qad ja'altumul laaha 'alaikum kafeelaa; innal laaha ya'lamu maa taf'aloon

92.t: Do not be like the woman who ˹foolishly˺ unravels her yarn after it is firmly spun, by taking your oaths as a means of deceiving one another in favour of a stronger group. Surely Allah tests you through this. And on the Day of Judgment He will certainly make your differences clear to you
92.tr: Wa-laa takoonoo kallatee naqadat ghazlahaa mim ba'di quwwatin ankaasaa; tattakhizoona aimaanakum dakhlalam bainakum an takoona ummatun hiya arbaa min ummah; innnamaa yablookumul laahu bih; Wa-la-yubaiyyinanna lakum yawmal Qiyaamati maa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon

93.t: Had Allah willed, He could have easily made you one community ˹of believers˺, but He leaves to stray whoever He wills and guides whoever He wills. And you will certainly be questioned about what you used to do
93.tr: Wa-law shaaa'al laahu laja'alakum ummmatanw waahidatanw Wa-laakien yudillu maien yashaaa'u Wa-yahdee maien yashaaa'; Wa-latus'alunna 'ammaa kuntum ta'maloon

94.t: And do not take your oaths as a means of deceiving one another or your feet will slip after they have been firm. Then you will taste the evil ˹consequences˺ of hindering ˹others˺ from the Way of Allah, and you will suffer a tremendous punishment
94.tr: Wa-laa tattakhizooo aimaanakum dakhalam bainakum fatazilla qadamum ba'da subootihaa Wa-tazooqus sooo'a bimmaa sadattum 'an sabeelil laahi Wa-lakum 'azaabun 'azeem

95.t: And do not trade Allah’s covenant for a fleeting gain. What is with Allah is certainly far better for you, if only you knew
95.tr: Wa-laa tashtaroo bi-'ahdil laahi samanan qaleelaa; innamaa 'indal laahi huwa khairul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon

96.t: Whatever you have will end, but whatever Allah has is everlasting. And We will certainly reward the steadfast according to the best of their deeds
96.tr: maa 'indakum yanfadu Wa-maa 'indal laahi baaq; Wa-lanajziyannal lazeena sabarooo ajjrahum bi-ahsani maa kaanoo ya'maloon

97.t: Whoever does good, whether male or female, and is a believer, We will surely bless them with a good life, and We will certainly reward them according to the best of their deeds
97.tr: Man 'amila saaliham min zakarin aw unsaa Wa-huwa mu'minun falanuhyiyannahoo hayaatan taiiyibatanw Wa-lanajzi-yannnahum ajrahum bi-ahsani maa kaanoo ya'maloon

98.t: When you recite the Quran, seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed
98.tr: Fa-izaa qara-tal Quraana fasta'iz billaahi minashh Shai-taanir rajeem

99.t: He certainly has no authority over those who believe and put their trust in their Lord
99.tr: Innahoo laisa lahoo sultaanun 'alal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'alaa Rabbihim yatawakkaloon

100.t: His authority is only over those who take him as a patron and who—under his influence—associate ˹others˺ with Allah ˹in worship˺
100.tr: Innnamaa sultaanuhoo 'alal lazeena yatawallawnahoo wallazeena hum bihee mushrikoon

101.t: When We replace a verse with another—and Allah knows best what He reveals—they say, “You ˹Muḥammad˺ are just a fabricator.” In fact, most of them do not know
101.tr: Wa-izaa baddalnaaa Aayatam makaana Aayatinw wal-laahu a'lamu bimaa yunazzilu qaalooo innamaa anta muftar; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoon

102.t: Say, “The holy spirit has brought it down from your Lord with the truth to reassure the believers, and as a guide and good news for those who submit ˹to Allah˺.”
102.tr: Qul nazzalahoo Roohul Qudusi mir Rabbika bilhaqqi liyusabbital lazeena aamanoo Wa-hudanw Wa-bushraa lilmuslimeen

103.t: And We surely know that they say, “No one is teaching him except a human.” But the man they refer to speaks a foreign tongue, whereas this ˹Quran˺ is ˹in˺ eloquent Arabic
103.tr: Wa-laqad na'lamu annahum yaqooloona innamaa yu'allimuhoo bashar; lisaanul lazee yulhidoona ilaihi a'ja-miyyunw Wa-haaza lisaanun 'Arabiyyum mubeen

104.t: Surely those who do not believe in Allah’s revelations will never be guided by Allah, and they will suffer a painful punishment
104.tr: Innal lazeena laa yu'minoona bi-Aayaatil laahi laa yahdehimul laahu Wa-lahum 'azaabun aleem

105.t: No one fabricates lies except those who disbelieve in Allah’s revelations, and it is they who are the ˹true˺ liars
105.tr: Innamaa yaftaril kazibal lazeena laa yu'minoona bi-Aayaatil laahi Wa-ulaaa'ika humul kaaziboon

106.t: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after their belief—not those who are forced while their hearts are firm in faith, but those who embrace disbelief wholeheartedly—they will be condemned by Allah and suffer a tremendous punishment
106.tr: Man kafara billaahi mim ba'di eemaanihee illaa man ukriha Wa-qalbuhoo mutmma'innum bil-eemaani Wa-laakim man sharaha bilkufri sadran fa'alaihim ghadabum minal laahi Wa-lahum 'azaabun 'azeem

107.t: This is because they prefer the life of this world over the Hereafter. Surely Allah never guides those who ˹choose to˺ disbelieve
107.tr: Zaalika bi-annahumus tahabbul hayaatad dunyaa 'alal Aakhirati Wa-annal laaha laa yahdil qawmal kaafireen

108.t: They are the ones whose hearts, ears, and eyes are sealed by Allah, and it is they who are ˹truly˺ heedless
108.tr: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena taba'al laahu 'alaa quloobihim Wa-sam'ihim Wa-absaarihim Wa-ulaaa'ika humul ghaafiloon

109.t: Without a doubt, they will be the losers in the Hereafter
109.tr: Laa jarama annnahum fil Aakhirati humul khassiroon

110.t: As for those who emigrated after being compelled ˹to renounce Islam˺, then struggled ˹in Allah’s cause˺, and persevered, your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ is truly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful after all
110.tr: Summa inna Rabbaka lillazeena haajaroo mim ba'dimaa futinoo summma jaahadoo Wa-sabaroo inna Rabbaka mim ba'dihaa la Ghafoorur Raheem

111.t: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ every soul will come pleading for itself, and each will be paid in full for what it did, and none will be wronged
111.tr: Yawma taatee kullu nafsin tujaadilu 'an nafsihaa Wa-tuwaffaa kullu nafsim maa 'amilat Wa-hum laa yuzlamoon

112.t: And Allah sets forth the example of a society which was safe and at ease, receiving its provision in abundance from all directions. But its people met Allah’s favours with ingratitude, so Allah made them taste the clutches of hunger and fear for their misdeeds
112.tr: Wa-darabal laahu masalan qaryatan kaanat aaminatam mutma'innataien yaaateehaa rizquhaa raghadam min kulli makaanin fakafarat bi-an'umil laahi fa-azaaqahal laahu libaasal joo'i walkhawfi bimaa kaanoo yasna'oon

113.t: A messenger of their own actually did come to them, but they denied him. So the torment overtook them while they persisted in wrongdoing
113.tr: Wa-laqad jaaa'ahum Rasoolum minhum fakazzaboohu fa-akhazahumul 'azaabu Wa-hum zaalimoon

114.t: So eat from the good, lawful things which Allah has provided for you, and be grateful for Allah’s favours, if you ˹truly˺ worship Him ˹alone˺
114.tr: Fakuloo mimmaa razaqa-kumul laahu halaalan taiyyibanw washkuroo ni'matal laahi in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon

115.t: He has only forbidden you ˹to eat˺ carrion, blood, swine, and what is slaughtered in the name of any other than Allah. But if someone is compelled by necessity—neither driven by desire nor exceeding immediate need—then surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
115.tr: Innamaa harama 'alai-kumul maitata waddama Wa-lahmal khinzeeri Wa-maaa uhilla lighairil laahi bihee famanid turra ghaira baaghinw Wa-laa 'aadin fa-innal laaha Ghafoorur Raheem

116.t: Do not falsely declare with your tongues, “This is lawful, and that is unlawful,” ˹only˺ fabricating lies against Allah. Indeed, those who fabricate lies against Allah will never succeed
116.tr: Wa-laa taqooloo limaa tasifu alsinatukumul kaziba haaza halaalunw Wa-haazaa haraamul litaftaroo 'alal laahil kazib; innal lazeena yaftaroona 'alal laahil kaziba laa yuflihoon

117.t: ˹It is only˺ a brief enjoyment, then they will suffer a painful punishment

118.t: To the Jews, We have forbidden what We related to you before. We did not wrong them, but it was they who wronged themselves
118.tr: Wa-'alal lazeena haadoo harramnaa ma qasasnaa 'alaika min qablu Wa-maa zalamanaahum Wa-laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon

119.t: As for those who commit evil ignorantly ˹or recklessly˺, then repent afterwards and mend their ways, then your Lord is surely All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
119.tr: Summma inna Rabbaka lillazeena 'amilus sooo'a bijahaalatin summa taaboo mim ba'di zaaalika Wa-aslahoo inna Rabbaka mim ba'dihaa la-Ghafoorur Raheem

120.t: Indeed, Abraham was a model of excellence: devoted to Allah, ˹perfectly˺ upright—not a polytheist—
120.tr: Inna Ibraaheema kaana ummatan qaanital lillaahi Haneefanw Wa-lam yaku minal mushrikeen

121.t: ˹utterly˺ grateful for Allah’s favours. ˹So˺ He chose him and guided him to the Straight Path
121.tr: Shaakiral li-an'umih; ijtabaahu Wa-hadaahu ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

122.t: We blessed him with all goodness in this world, and in the Hereafter he will certainly be among the righteous
122.tr: Wa-aatainaahu fid dunyaa hasanah; Wa-innahoo fil Aakhirati laminas saaliheen

123.t: Then We revealed to you ˹O Prophet, saying˺: “Follow the faith of Abraham, the upright, who was not one of the polytheists.”
123.tr: Summma awhainaa ilaika anit tabi' Millata Ibraaheema haneefaa; Wa-maa kaana minal mushrikeen

124.t: ˹Honouring˺ the Sabbath was ordained only for those who disputed about Abraham. And surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their disputes
124.tr: Innnamaa ju'ilas Sabtu 'alal lazeenakhtalafoo feeh; Wa-inna Rabbaka la yahkumu bainahum Yawmal Qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon

125.t: Invite ˹all˺ to the Way of your Lord with wisdom and kind advice, and only debate with them in the best manner. Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
125.tr: Ud'u ilaa sabeeli Rabbika bilhikmati walmaw-'izatil hasanati Wa-jaadilhum billatee hiya ahsan; inna Rabbaka huwa a'almu biman dalla 'an sabeelihee Wa-Huwa a'lamu bilmuhtadeen

126.t: If you retaliate, then let it be equivalent to what you have suffered. But if you patiently endure, it is certainly best for those who are patient
126.tr: Wa-in 'aaqabtum fa'aaqiboo bimisli maa 'ooqibtum bihee Wa-la'in sabartum lahuwa khairul lissaabireen

127.t: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺, for your patience is only with Allah’s help. Do not grieve over those ˹who disbelieve˺, nor be distressed by their schemes
127.tr: Wasbir Wa-maa sabruka illaa billaah; Wa-laa tahzan 'alaihim Wa-laa taku fee daiqim mimmaa yamkuroon

128.t: Surely Allah is with those who shun evil and who do good ˹deeds˺
128.tr: Innal laaha ma'al lazeenat taqaw wal-lazeena hum muhsinoon
